descriptionHtml:
Bug B22 · fixed on 43c38a4f · was P1 · no longer counted

Billing follows the admission badge, not the template chosen at Generate: New Admission / Consult patients written as SOAP get admission / consult codes instead of 99231–99233

Tickets: UAT TC-06 (TFA-92584 ready for qa); TFA-92596 AC 1 ready for pr (fix in PR #103) · counts as a QA bug: yes (fix in PR #103) · found on: dev + local

Note: Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92584): AC 6 itself says only 'preselected and changeable'; billing following the template comes from UAT TC-06 and TFA-92596. Q9 waits on Daniela. Re-test 2026-10-15 on 43c38a4f (PR #110): fixed. Local: 16 server-job cells and UAT step 4 in the app; dev: d1–d8 and step 4 (New Admission + SOAP gives 99231).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-06/S24

Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S04 Family follows the template, never the badge, the note's wording or an instruction in the note (badge x template, plus five note-text traps)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 Billing follows the template selected at Generate, not the admission-status badge: with the badge on New Admission and the template overridden to SOAP progress at Generate, the code comes from 99231- … (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 1; TFA-92599 How it works 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U1 The code family is a fixed table keyed on the template, never chosen by the model: H&P and Consult -> 99221-99223 (some commercial payers accept 99252-99255); SOAP progress -> 99231-99233; … (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 1; TFA-92596 What (template -> family table)) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U4 The final generated note is the source of truth; the model only suggests the level within the family the template fixed. (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U7 Discharge (Hospital 99238 / 99239, SNF 99315 / 99316): if the time is in the note, the code is set from it (<= 30 min -> 99238 / 99315, > 30 min -> 99239 / 99316); … (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 5; TFA-92596 What (SNF discharge new family)) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Notes from S03 sent with a badge that does not match the template (d1-d8), and notes whose wording tempts another family or contains a line addressed to the coder (i1-i5, formerly S19)

When Run the billing step once per cell

Then Every code comes from the template's family; the badge, the words 'admitted', 'readmitted' or 'follow-up' in the note and an instruction to bill another code change nothing; a discharge with no time still asks for the time

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): codeIn = the template's family (U1) whatever encounterType says or the note asks: i1, i2 99231-99233 and never 99223; i4 99307-99310; i5 99304-99306; i3 asksForTime + noCode. Consult-note cell Q1 as in S03. minQuotes 1 on every non-discharge cell; d5 asksForTime false + noLevelWords; levelMatchesCode, quotesInNote, noReasoning (oracleRules 4-8). …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method CODEREVIEW · Code review; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S04 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-18.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; the Allure status was changed by the triage from passed to failed.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92584 ready for qa; TFA-92596 ready for qa; TFA-92599 in progress

A SOAP progress note on a New Admission or Consult patient is billed from the admission or consult family (99221–99223 / 99252–99255) instead of 99231–99233, and Nursing Home consult and discharge notes are billed as follow-ups.

Evidence: Allure fbdba8a4, code-review known-gap. Recorded gaps in the code-review targets: badge-family, no-discharge-time-prompt, no-snf-consult-discharge-family. Dev report §2 #3 (U44, TFA-92584 AC 6). The fix is in PR #103 (TFA-92596 ready for pr). Consult note → 99221 vs 99252 is Q1.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 43c38a4 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-14T21:30:04Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane newspec-c (newspec-c/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: CODEREVIEW · Code review; secondary: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev/newspec-c.
